messages:
kim: Quick micro-poll — printing a new office mug sticker set for summer. Reply with the option letter or an emoji.
kim: ```
A) Minimal Redwood logo
B) Pixel model (retro)
C) Mushroom mascot
D) "Ship & Scale" quote
```
leon: B :raised_hands: vote for the retro pixel one
anya: C :mushroom: tiny mushroom gang
sam: A :thumbsup: keeping it classic
olivia: D I kinda want the quote, though
kim: Thanks! Tally so far: B(1), C(1), A(1), D(1) — close.
dev-bot: Poll created by kim. Reminder set: results posted Fri 3pm.
leon: maybe do a two-sided mug? Pixel on one side, quote on the other? :thinking_face:
anya: ooo that could work. double sided sounds good to me
sam: double-sided would be cool if budget allows
olivia: if we have to pick one, i'm switching to B
kim: Ok final quick check — anyone switching? last call
anya: staying C
leon: B still
sam: A still
olivia: B
kim: Closing poll in ~30m. Thanks everyone :party_parrot:
